---
title: "NanoString quality-control report"
brand: _brand.yml
params:
  nacho_rds: ""
knitr:
  opts_chunk:
    fig.retina: 1
format:
  html:
    embed-resources: true
    toc: true
    toc-depth: 2
    number-sections: true
    fig-width: 7
    fig-height: 4.5
    fig-dpi: 96
  typst:
    font-paths: fonts
    fig-format: png
    toc: true
    section-numbering: "1.1"
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
report <- NACHO:::report_setup(params$nacho_rds)
x <- report$object
```

# Summary

```{r}
#| label: summary
#| output: asis
cat(NACHO:::report_overview(x), sep = "\n")
cat("\n\n")
cat(NACHO:::report_callouts(x), sep = "\n")
```

# Settings and thresholds

```{r}
#| label: thresholds
#| output: asis
cat(NACHO:::report_thresholds(x), sep = "\n")
```

```{r}
#| label: body
#| output: asis
#| fig-alt: !expr report$sections$alt[!is.na(report$sections$plot)]
NACHO:::report_body(report)
```
